question.text: Paragraph: The coordination number of $\mathrm{Ni}^{2+}$ is 4 . $\mathrm{NiCl}_2+\mathrm{KCN}$ (excess) $\rightarrow A$ (cyano complex) $\mathrm{NiCl}_2+$ conc. $\mathrm{HCl}$ (excess) $\rightarrow B$ (chloro complex)Question: The hybridization of $A$ and $B$ are

solution.text: Hybridisation of $\mathrm{Ni}$ in $\mathrm{K}_2\left[\mathrm{Ni}(\mathrm{CN})_4\right]$ is $d s p^2$ and in $\mathrm{K}_2\left[\mathrm{Ni}^2\left(\mathrm{Cl}_4\right)\right]$ is $s p^3$ (Detail see in question no. 25).
